children: Greece's jobless rate stood at 7.9% in July, down from an upwardly revised 8.1% in June, data from statistics service ELSTAT showed on Monday.
Seasonally adjusted data showed 376,508 people were officially unemployed.
Unemployment impacted women more than men, at the rates of 10.4% and 5.9%, respectively.
The jobless rate for young people aged 15 to 24 years dropped to 16.8% in July from 20.4% in the same month in 2025, ELSTAT said.
